title: Close /ff shelf loop gaps
objective: Stop the /ff shelf loop from being an agent-improvised path, and stop shallow/grafted clones from false-parking unique tips. Own shelf mutate in one script. Compare catch-up tips by SHA first; use rev-list counts only on full history after SHA differs.
success_criteria: ff_shelf refuses process substitution and any /tmp files-from; writes $CLONE/.l9/ff-shelf-untracked.txt then rsync --files-from that path
git add uses --pathspec-from-file on that list in a command that does not also commit or status
an already-open same-author feat/ff-shelf-* PR is appended; a second stamp branch is not created
post-shelf prune unlinks unstamped leftover *.plan.md whose kernel-normalized body matches the open-PR blob at the same path
slash and execute.md name ff_shelf as the only shelf mutate path; ff.sh stays push-off
l9-repo-sync validate_pack_structure and self_test PASS; prune pack_self_test covers the donor case; .pre-commit-config.yaml is the hook catalog

ff.sh: HEAD SHA == origin/main SHA is at-tip (no preserve, no reset, AHEAD/BEHIND treated as 0). Shallow/grafted + SHA unequal never creates l9/ff-preserve-* from rev-list counts. Full history preserves only when HEAD is not an ancestor of origin/main. No unshallow. No merge --ff-only.

stress_test.blast_radius: A wrong prune absorb deletes unique leftover plans. A wrong append lands corpus on a foreign shelf PR. A docs-only patch leaves the next /ff hitting the same /tmp and sibling denials. A wrong SHA-first rule drops a real unique main commit on full history or keeps false-parking shallow tips. Building from 91daac4 or origin/main while #499 is open creates a sibling chain. Running /ff as P4 shelves these plan files.
stress_test.rollback: Revert the feature commit(s) on the Build branch. After revert, ff.sh returns to the rev-list preserve path (known shallow false-park). Isolation gates stay. Restore execute.md recipes from origin/main only when ff_shelf.py is also reverted.
